transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because since my sister and her baby moved back home, I’ve just been more on edge and kind of down than usual. I keep snapping over little stuff at home, and then I show up to class or the shop already drained. I’m still getting by, but I’ve missed a couple deadlines and I backed out of helping with the theater set because I couldn’t keep everything straight.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a month now. It really started after my sister and her baby moved back into the house.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy, like hobbies, work, or time with friends and family?
I don’t think so, not really. I still like the same things when I actually get to them. I’ve just been more tired and distracted, so I don’t always feel up for doing much.
Have you felt down, sad, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, since your sister and her baby moved in?

Not most of the day every day, no. I’ve definitely been more down and on edge since they moved in, but it kind of comes and goes. It’s more like I get worn out at home, then I’m already drained when I get to class or work.
Have you noticed a significant decrease in your energy or an increase in fatigue nearly every day since your sister and her baby moved in?

Yeah, I’d say I’ve been more tired most days. Since my sister and the baby moved back in, I’m kind of on edge at home, and by the time I get to class or the shop I already feel drained. I’m still getting by, but it’s made it harder to keep up.
Have you been feeling more irritable or easily annoyed since your sister and her baby moved back home?

Yeah, definitely more irritable. I find myself snapping over little things at home, especially since my sister and the baby moved back in. It’s like I’m already on edge there, and then I go to class or the shop drained and annoyed. I’m still managing, but it’s been harder to keep stuff straight.
Have you had trouble concentrating or found it difficult to keep track of things since your sister and her baby moved in?

Yeah, I have. Not like I can’t focus at all, but since my sister and the baby moved in, I feel more scattered. I’ve missed a couple deadlines, and I backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight on top of class and the shop.
Have you had several days in a row where you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day since your sister and the baby moved in?

Yeah, there have been stretches like that. Since my sister and the baby moved back in, I’ve felt more down and kind of on edge most days. I’m still doing what I have to do, but it’s been harder, and I’ve pulled back from stuff like helping with the theater set because I just didn’t feel like I could keep up.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities you normally like?

Yeah, kind of. I haven’t totally stopped liking things, but I’ve pulled back from stuff I’d normally be up for, like helping with the theater set. I just feel drained and on edge from everything at home, and then by the time I’m at class or the shop, I don’t really have the energy or focus to enjoy it like I usually would.
Have you found that you don’t take pleasure or feel interested in things you usually enjoy, even when you have the chance to do them?

Yeah, somewhat. I still like those things, I guess, but since my sister and her baby moved back home I’ve been so on edge and worn out that I don’t really get into them the same way. Like with the theater set, I probably would’ve enjoyed helping, but I backed out because I couldn’t keep everything straight with class and the shop too.
